reader.zh-Hant: PageDOMScraperTool 用於抓取完整頁面內容，預設回傳 HTML DOM；可選擇允許 JSON/非 HTML 文字內容，並套用安全的外連政策。
reader.en: PageDOMScraperTool fetches full page content, returning HTML DOM by default and optionally allowing JSON/non-HTML text under outbound safety policy.
reader.ja: PageDOMScraperTool は通常 HTML DOM を返し、必要時に JSON/非 HTML テキストを許可できます。外向き通信の安全ポリシーを適用します。

symbols.name: PageDOMScraperTool
symbols.summary: Fetch full HTML DOM for parser development and debugging.

tool_contract.name: scrape_page_dom
tool_contract.description: Fetch full page HTML DOM from a URL with optional dynamic rendering.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(url: str, render_dynamic: bool = True, dynamic_wait_ms: int = 1800, allow_non_html: bool = False, accept_json: bool = False, save_policy: str = 'inline', output_target: str = 'memory', output_path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]
methods.summary: Returns HTML DOM by default; can return JSON/non-HTML text when explicitly allowed, with render/safety metadata.

runtime_notes.content: When dynamic rendering is requested but unavailable, tool falls back to static HTTP and records render_notice.
By default, non-HTML content is rejected. Set accept_json=true (or allow_non_html=true) to return textual JSON/non-HTML bodies.
Requests to localhost/private IP targets are blocked by safety policy before network fetch.
Supports save_policy/output_target/output_path to avoid large inline DOM payloads in conversation history.
